subtitle: "Choose a National Park Service unit, filter by category, or narrow the years shown to inspect its summary statistics and yearly attendance"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false

---

```{r}
#| label: unified-park-explorer
#| column: page-inset

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

annual_visits <- read_csv(
  "nps_annual_visits_1979_2025.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2025) |>
  mutate(
    suffix = word(park, -1),
    park_type = case_when(
      suffix %in% c("NP", "NPRES", "PRES") ~ "National Parks & Preserves",
      suffix %in% c("NRA", "NS", "NL", "PKWY", "NR", "NSR", "W&SR", "NRRA") ~ "Recreation Areas, Seashores & Parkways",
      suffix %in% c("NM", "Monument") ~ "National Monuments",
      TRUE ~ "Historic Sites, Battlefields & Memorials"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    annual_rank = min_rank(desc(recreation_visits)),
    reporting_units = n()
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(park, year)

park_payload <- annual_visits |>
  group_by(park, park_type) |>
  summarize(
    years = list(year),
    visits = list(recreation_visits),
    ranks = list(annual_rank),
    units = list(reporting_units),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

parks_json <- toJSON(park_payload, auto_unbox = TRUE)

ui <- HTML(paste0(
'

    <p style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#5A6B60;margin:8px 2px 0 2px;line-height:1.4;">

<!-- 3. BOTTOM: Individual Yearly Visitation Graph for the Selected Park -->
<div style="background:#FAF7F0;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px 10px 20px;margin-top:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(30,56,43,0.04);">

<script>
(() => {
  const PARKS = ', parks_json, ';
  const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");

  const C = {
    pineDark: "#1B3326",
    pineMid: "#2D533E",
    pineSoft: "#426B53",
    sageMid: "#678B74",
    sageLight: "#98B4A0",
    sageMist: "#B8CBB9",
    cream: "#FAF7F0",
    sandSky1: "#E2DAC2",
    sandSky2: "#ECE5D1",
    sandSky3: "#F5F0E2",
    ochreSun: "#D89E44",
    ochreMid: "#E6BC72",
    ochreGlow: "#F4E4B8",
    terracotta: "#B06242",
    terraMid: "#944D32",
    terraDark: "#703723",
    waterDeep: "#355C61",
    waterMid: "#4E7A7E",
    waterLight: "#8BAEB0",
    stoneLight: "#DCD7C8",
    stoneMid: "#A2AAA1",
    stoneDark: "#6E7871"
  };

  function esc(s) {
    return s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }

  function medianValue(arr) {
    if (!arr.length) return 0;
    const s = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const mid = Math.floor(s.length / 2);
    return s.length % 2 ? s[mid] : Math.round((s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2);
  }

  function classifyMotif(park, parkType) {
    const p = park;
    if (/Gateway Arch/i.test(p)) return { id: "gateway_arch", label: "Gateway Arch & Riverfront" };
    if (/Statue of Liberty|Castle Clinton|Governors Island/i.test(p)) return { id: "liberty", label: "Harbor Torch & Crown" };
    if (/Golden Gate|New River Gorge/i.test(p)) return { id: "bridge", label: "Suspension Span & Headlands" };
    if (/Yosemite|Kings Canyon/i.test(p)) return { id: "halfdome", label: "El Capitan, Half Dome & Valley" };
    if (/Yellowstone|Hot Springs/i.test(p)) return { id: "geyser", label: "Geyser Plume & Hot-Spring Pool" };
    if (/Arches|Natural Bridges|Rainbow Bridge/i.test(p)) return { id: "arch", label: "Sandstone Arch & Red-Rock Buttes" };
    if (/Saguaro|Organ Pipe|Casa Grande|Tonto|Coronado|Tumacacori/i.test(p)) return { id: "saguaro", label: "Sonoran Saguaros & Bajadas" };
    if (/Joshua Tree|Mojave|Death Valley/i.test(p)) return { id: "joshua", label: "Joshua Trees & Granite Boulders" };
    if (/White Sands|Sand Dunes|Indiana Dunes|Sleeping Bear Dunes/i.test(p)) return { id: "dunes", label: "Wind-Sculpted Dune Ridges" };
    if (/Cave|Caverns/i.test(p)) return { id: "cave", label: "Limestone Cavern & Stalactites" };
    if (/Redwood|Sequoia|Muir Woods|Congaree|Big Thicket/i.test(p)) return { id: "redwood", label: "Ancient Giant Grove & Sunbeams" };
    if (/Volcano|Crater Lake|Mount Rainier|Lassen|Haleakala|Denali|Katmai|Wrangell|Lake Clark|Capulin|Sunset Crater|El Malpais|Lava Beds|Craters of the Moon/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "volcano", label: "Glaciated Peak & Caldera Lake" };
    }
    if (/Everglades|Biscayne|Dry Tortugas|Virgin Islands|Big Cypress|American Samoa|Buck Island|Salt River Bay|Kaloko|Pu`uhonua|Puukohola|Channel Islands|De Soto|Canaveral|Jean Lafitte/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "tropics", label: "Coastal Palms, Heron & Lagoon" };
    }
    if (/Acadia|\bNS\b|\bNL\b|Point Reyes|Cape |Island|Maritime|New Bedford|Salem Maritime|Olympic|Kenai Fjords|Glacier Bay/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "lighthouse", label: "Headland Lighthouse & Sea Stacks" };
    }
    if (/Canyon|Zion|Bryce|Badlands|Big Bend|Capitol Reef|Mesa Verde|Petrified Forest|Pinnacles|Guadalupe|Chiricahua|Bandelier|Chaco|Colorado NM|Dinosaur|El Morro|Gila|Hovenweep|Montezuma|Navajo|Salinas|Walnut|Wupatki|Aztec|Bighorn Canyon|Curecanti|Lake Meredith|Amistad/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "canyon", label: "Tiered Canyon Cliffs & River" };
    }
    if (/\bPKWY\b|Great Smoky|Shenandoah|Appalachian|Blue Ridge|Catoctin|Cumberland Gap|Delaware Water Gap/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "parkway", label: "Misty Ridges & Scenic Parkway" };
    }
    if (/\bMEM\b|Washington MON|Lincoln|Jefferson/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "memorial", label: "Classical Colonnade & Reflecting Pool" };
    }
    if (/Fort |\bNB\b|\bNMP\b|\bNBS\b|Battlefield|Gettysburg|Vicksburg|Shiloh|Antietam|Yorktown|Saratoga|Chickamauga|Manassas|Fredericksburg|Petersburg|Appomattox|Minute Man|Valley Forge|Guilford|Kings Mountain|Cowpens|Pea Ridge|Wilson\'s Creek|Kennesaw|Stones River|Monocacy|Richmond|Castillo/i.test(p)) {
      return { id: "fort", label: "Stone Bastion, Cannon & Flag" };
    }
    if (parkType === "Historic Sites, Battlefields & Memorials") {
      return { id: "heritage", label: "Heritage Hall & Bell Cupola" };
    }
    return { id: "alpine", label: "Alpine Peaks, Spruce Forest & River" };
  }

  function detailedPine(x, baseY, h, colDark, colLit) {
    const t1 = h * 0.22, t2 = h * 0.30, t3 = h * 0.38, t4 = h * 0.46;
    const lit = colLit || C.pineSoft;
    return `
      <rect x="${(x - h * 0.04).toFixed(1)}" y="${(baseY - h * 0.12).toFixed(1)}" width="${(h * 0.08).toFixed(1)}" height="${(h * 0.16).toFixed(1)}" fill="${C.pineDark}"/>
      <polygon points="${x},${baseY - h} ${x - t1},${baseY - h * 0.68} ${x + t1},${baseY - h * 0.68}" fill="${colDark}"/>
      <polygon points="${x},${baseY - h} ${x + t1},${baseY - h * 0.68} ${x},${baseY - h * 0.68}" fill="${lit}" fill-opacity="0.45"/>
      <polygon points="${x},${baseY - h * 0.78} ${x - t2},${baseY - h * 0.46} ${x + t2},${baseY - h * 0.46}" fill="${colDark}"/>
      <polygon points="${x},${baseY - h * 0.78} ${x + t2},${baseY - h * 0.46} ${x},${baseY - h * 0.46}" fill="${lit}" fill-opacity="0.4"/>
      <polygon points="${x},${baseY - h * 0.56} ${x - t3},${baseY - h * 0.22} ${x + t3},${baseY - h * 0.22}" fill="${colDark}"/>
      <polygon points="${x},${baseY - h * 0.36} ${x - t4},${baseY} ${x + t4},${baseY}" fill="${colDark}"/>
    `;
  }

  function bird(x, y, s) {
    return `<path d="M${x - 7 * s},${y + 2 * s} Q${x - 3 * s},${y - 4 * s} ${x},${y} Q${x + 3 * s},${y - 4 * s} ${x + 7 * s},${y + 2 * s}" fill="none" stroke="${C.pineMid}" stroke-width="${(1.4 * s).toFixed(1)}" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  }

  function cloud(x, y, w) {
    const h = w * 0.22;
    return `<path d="M${x},${y} L${x + w},${y} C${x + w},${y - h * 0.6} ${x + w * 0.82},${y - h * 0.65} ${x + w * 0.76},${y - h * 0.45} C${x + w * 0.68},${y - h} ${x + w * 0.42},${y - h} ${x + w * 0.34},${y - h * 0.5} C${x + w * 0.22},${y - h * 0.75} ${x},${y - h * 0.55} ${x},${y} Z" fill="${C.cream}" fill-opacity="0.72"/>`;

          <rect x="134" y="218" width="44" height="30" fill="${C.cream}" stroke="${C.pineDark}" stroke-width="1.4"/>

          <polygon points="187,128 200,113 213,128" fill="${C.pineDark}"/>
          <line x1="200" y1="113" x2="200" y2="105" stroke="${C.pineDark}" stroke-width="2"/>
          <path d="M28,246 L128,238 L234,252 L308,308 L292,382 L28,382 Z" fill="${C.pineMid}"/>

          <path d="M276,326 Q304,316 334,328" fill="none" stroke="${C.cream}" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          ${detailedPine(58, 258, 72, C.pineDark)}
          ${detailedPine(94, 252, 58, C.pineDark)}
          ${detailedPine(118, 256, 46, C.pineMid)}
        `;

      case "arch":
        return `
          <polygon points="46,282 78,224 166,224 198,282" fill="${C.terracotta}" fill-opacity="0.58"/>
          <line x1="66" y1="246" x2="178" y2="246" stroke="${C.ochreGlow}" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-opacity="0.55"/>

          <rect x="28" y="280" width="584" height="102" fill="${C.terracotta}"/>

          <path d="M188,338 L214,234 C232,148 286,108 356,108 C428,108 478,152 496,238 L522,338 L434,338 L426,258 C416,194 390,164 356,164 C318,164 290,196 280,260 L270,338 Z" fill="${C.terraDark}"/>
          <path d="M204,338 L228,238 C244,158 294,118 356,118 C420,118 466,160 482,242 L504,338 L446,338 L438,256 C428,188 396,158 356,158 C312,158 282,190 270,258 L260,338 Z" fill="${C.terracotta}"/>
          <path d="M236,216 C264,156 308,128 356,128 C398,128 434,150 456,196" fill="none" stroke="${C.ochreMid}" stroke-width="3" stroke-opacity="0.55"/>
          <path d="M28,324 Q195,296 368,324 T612,314 L612,382 L28,382 Z" fill="${C.pineDark}"/>
          <ellipse cx="116" cy="336" rx="14" ry="9" fill="${C.pineSoft}"/>

      case "halfdome":
        return `
          <polygon points="28,118 176,138 222,296 28,296" fill="${C.stoneMid}"/>

          <path d="M312,134 C338,92 428,96 458,188 L492,296 L450,296 C428,202 380,148 312,144 Z" fill="${C.stoneMid}" fill-opacity="0.5"/>
          <line x1="312" y1="134" x2="312" y2="296" stroke="${C.pineDark}" stroke-width="2.5"/>
          <polygon points="486,296 554,178 612,206 612,296" fill="${C.stoneDark}"/>

          <path d="M28,324 Q320,304 612,326 L612,382 L28,382 Z" fill="${C.pineDark}"/>
          <path d="M276,382 C298,350 262,322 294,294 L324,294 C304,322 346,348 332,382 Z" fill="${C.waterLight}"/>
          <line x1="292" y1="336" x2="318" y2="336" stroke="${C.cream}" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-opacity="0.7"/>
          ${detailedPine(62, 332, 96, C.pineDark)}
          ${detailedPine(108, 338, 74, C.pineDark)}
          ${detailedPine(152, 334, 58, C.pineMid)}
          ${detailedPine(498, 336, 64, C.pineMid)}
          ${detailedPine(542, 334, 82, C.pineDark)}
          ${detailedPine(584, 330, 98, C.pineDark)}
        `;

      case "geyser":
        return `
          <path d="M28,284 Q320,264 612,284 L612,382 L28,382 Z" fill="${C.pineMid}"/>

  function buildHorizontalEmblemSVG(d, yrs, vis) {
    const motif = classifyMotif(d.park, d.park_type);
    const n = yrs.length;
    const maxV = Math.max(...vis, 1);
    const minV = Math.min(...vis);
    const peakIdx = vis.indexOf(Math.max(...vis));
    const latestIdx = n - 1;

    const peakFrac = n > 1 ? peakIdx / (n - 1) : 0.5;
    const sunX = 136 + peakFrac * 368;
    const sunY = 104;
    const sunR = 22 + 2.6 * Math.log10(maxV + 10);

    const xL = 28, xR = 612;
    let ridgePts = [`${xL},298`];
    let backRidgePts = [`${xL},298`];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = xL + ((xR - xL) * i) / Math.max(n - 1, 1);
      const norm = (vis[i] - minV) / Math.max(maxV - minV, 1);
      const y = 256 - norm * 54;
      ridgePts.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`);
      backRidgePts.push(`${x.toFixed(1)},${(y - 14 + 6 * Math.sin(i * 0.7)).toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    ridgePts.push(`${xR},298`);
    backRidgePts.push(`${xR},298`);

    const nameLen = d.park.length;
    const bannerFont = nameLen > 38 ? 14.5 : (nameLen > 28 ? 16.5 : 18.5);

    return `
      <title id="art-svg-title">${esc(d.park)} (${yrs[0]}–${yrs[latestIdx]})</title>
      <desc id="art-svg-desc">${esc(motif.label)} illustration for ${esc(d.park)} across ${yrs[0]}–${yrs[latestIdx]}.</desc>
      <defs>
        <clipPath id="landscape-scene-clip">
          <rect x="28" y="28" width="584" height="354" rx="8"/>
        </clipPath>
      </defs>

      <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="450" rx="12" fill="${C.pineDark}"/>
      <rect x="12" y="12" width="616" height="426" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="${C.sandSky1}" stroke-width="1.4"/>

      <g clip-path="url(#landscape-scene-clip)">
        <rect x="28" y="28" width="584" height="354" fill="${C.sandSky3}"/>
        <rect x="28" y="28" width="584" height="148" fill="${C.sandSky2}"/>
        <rect x="28" y="28" width="584" height="72" fill="${C.sandSky1}"/>

        <circle cx="${sunX.toFixed(1)}" cy="${sunY}" r="${(sunR + 28).toFixed(1)}" fill="${C.ochreGlow}" fill-opacity="0.34"/>
        <circle cx="${sunX.toFixed(1)}" cy="${sunY}" r="${(sunR + 12).toFixed(1)}" fill="${C.ochreGlow}" fill-opacity="0.72"/>
        <circle cx="${sunX.toFixed(1)}" cy="${sunY}" r="${sunR.toFixed(1)}" fill="${C.ochreSun}"/>

        ${cloud(72, 92, 92)}
        ${cloud(468, 82, 104)}
        ${bird(422, 96, 1.0)}
        ${bird(440, 88, 0.8)}
        ${bird(454, 99, 0.7)}

        <polygon points="${backRidgePts.join(" ")}" fill="${C.sageMist}"/>
        <polygon points="${ridgePts.join(" ")}" fill="${C.sageLight}"/>

        ${renderScene(motif.id)}
      </g>

      <rect x="28" y="28" width="584" height="354" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="${C.cream}" stroke-width="2.6"/>
      <rect x="28" y="394" width="584" height="34" rx="6" fill="${C.cream}"/>
      <text x="44" y="416" fill="${C.pineDark}" font-size="${bannerFont}" font-weight="700" font-family="Georgia, Palatino, serif">${esc(d.park)}</text>
      <text x="596" y="415" text-anchor="end" fill="#4A5B51" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.9" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif">${yrs[0]}–${yrs[latestIdx]} · PEAK ${yrs[peakIdx]}</text>
    `;
  }

  const catSel = document.getElementById("park-cat-filter");
  const parkSel = document.getElementById("park-art-select");
  const startSel = document.getElementById("year-start-select");
  const endSel = document.getElementById("year-end-select");

  for (let y = 2000; y <= 2025; y++) {
    const o1 = document.createElement("option");
    o1.value = y; o1.textContent = y;
    if (y === 2000) o1.selected = true;
    startSel.appendChild(o1);

    const o2 = document.createElement("option");
    o2.value = y; o2.textContent = y;
    if (y === 2025) o2.selected = true;
    endSel.appendChild(o2);
  }

  function populateParkDropdown(preferredPark) {
    const cat = catSel.value;
    parkSel.innerHTML = "";
    let chosenIdx = -1;
    PARKS.forEach((d, idx) => {
      if (cat === "ALL" || d.park_type === cat) {
        const opt = document.createElement("option");
        opt.value = idx;
        opt.textContent = d.park;
        if (d.park === preferredPark) {
          opt.selected = true;
          chosenIdx = idx;
        }
        parkSel.appendChild(opt);
      }
    });
    if (chosenIdx === -1 && parkSel.options.length > 0) {
      parkSel.options[0].selected = true;
    }
  }

  function renderAll() {
    const idx = Number(parkSel.value);
    const d = PARKS[idx];
    let y0 = Number(startSel.value);
    let y1 = Number(endSel.value);
    if (y0 > y1) {
      const tmp = y0; y0 = y1; y1 = tmp;
      startSel.value = y0;
      endSel.value = y1;
    }

    const yrs = [], vis = [], rnks = [], unts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < d.years.length; i++) {
      if (d.years[i] >= y0 && d.years[i] <= y1) {
        yrs.push(d.years[i]);
        vis.push(d.visits[i]);
        rnks.push(d.ranks[i]);
        unts.push(d.units[i]);
      }
    }

    // Fallback if park reported only outside chosen sub-window
    if (!yrs.length) {
      yrs.push(...d.years);
      vis.push(...d.visits);
      rnks.push(...d.ranks);
      unts.push(...d.units);
    }

    const n = yrs.length;
    const maxVal = Math.max(...vis);
    const minVal = Math.min(...vis);
    const peakIdx = vis.indexOf(maxVal);
    const minIdx = vis.indexOf(minVal);
    const latestIdx = n - 1;
    const medVal = medianValue(vis);
    const totVal = vis.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

    const motif = classifyMotif(d.park, d.park_type);
    document.getElementById("info-park-title").textContent = d.park;
    document.getElementById("park-art-category-badge").textContent = d.park_type;
    document.getElementById("park-art-motif-badge").textContent = motif.label;
    document.getElementById("stat-span").textContent = `${yrs[0]}–${yrs[latestIdx]} (${n} yrs)`;
    document.getElementById("stat-latest").textContent = `${fmt.format(vis[latestIdx])} (${yrs[latestIdx]})`;
    document.getElementById("stat-peak").textContent = `${yrs[peakIdx]} (${fmt.format(maxVal)})`;
    document.getElementById("stat-min").textContent = `${yrs[minIdx]} (${fmt.format(minVal)})`;
    document.getElementById("stat-median").textContent = fmt.format(medVal);
    document.getElementById("stat-total").textContent = fmt.format(totVal);

    document.getElementById("park-art-svg").innerHTML = buildHorizontalEmblemSVG(d, yrs, vis);

    // Update individual park Plotly chart underneath
    if (window.Plotly) {
      const hoverTxt = yrs.map((yr, i) =>
        `<b>${esc(d.park)}</b><br>` +
        `Calendar year: ${yr}<br>` +
        `Annual recreation visits: ${fmt.format(vis[i])}<br>` +
        `System rank: #${rnks[i]} of ${unts[i]} units<br>` +
        `Category: ${esc(d.park_type)}`
      );

      const traces = [
        {
          x: yrs,
          y: vis,
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "lines+markers",
          name: d.park,
          fill: "tozeroy",
          fillcolor: "rgba(103, 139, 116, 0.16)",
          line: { color: "#2F6B48", width: 3 },
          marker: { color: "#1B3326", size: 7.5, line: { color: "#FAF7F0", width: 1.3 } },
          text: hoverTxt,
          hovertemplate: "%{text}<extra></extra>",
          showlegend: false
        },
        {
          x: [yrs[peakIdx]],
          y: [vis[peakIdx]],
          type: "scatter",
          mode: "markers",
          name: "Peak Year",
          marker: { color: "#D89E44", size: 12, line: { color: "#1B3326", width: 1.8 } },
          text: [hoverTxt[peakIdx]],
          hovertemplate: "<b>Peak Year</b><br>%{text}<extra></extra>",
          showlegend: false
        }
      ];

      const layout = {
        title: {
          text: `<b>${esc(d.park)} — Yearly Recreation Visits (${yrs[0]}–${yrs[latestIdx]})</b>`,
          x: 0,
          xanchor: "left",
          font: { family: "Georgia, Palatino, serif", size: 17, color: "#1E382B" }
        },
        paper_bgcolor: "#FAF7F0",
        plot_bgcolor: "#FAF7F0",
        hovermode: "closest",
        hoverlabel: {
          bgcolor: "#FAF7F0",
          bordercolor: "#C8C2B0",
          font: { family: "system-ui, sans-serif", size: 12.5, color: "#1E382B" }
        },
        margin: { t: 48, r: 22, b: 44, l: 74 },
        xaxis: {
          title: "",
          tickformat: "d",
          dtick: yrs.length <= 12 ? 1 : (yrs.length <= 20 ? 2 : 5),
          showgrid: false,
          zeroline: false,
          tickfont: { color: "#4A5B51", size: 12 }
        },
        yaxis: {
          title: { text: "Annual recreation visits", font: { color: "#4A5B51", size: 12.5 } },
          rangemode: "tozero",
          gridcolor: "#E6E1D2",
          zeroline: false,
          tickfont: { color: "#4A5B51", size: 12 }
        },
        annotations: [
          {
            x: yrs[peakIdx],
            y: vis[peakIdx],
            text: `Peak (${yrs[peakIdx]}): ${fmt.format(vis[peakIdx])}`,
            showarrow: true,
            arrowhead: 2,
            arrowsize: 0.8,
            arrowcolor: "#1B3326",
            ax: yrs[peakIdx] > (yrs[0] + yrs[latestIdx]) / 2 ? -55 : 55,
            ay: -28,
            bgcolor: "#FAF7F0",
            bordercolor: "#D89E44",
            borderwidth: 1.2,
            font: { size: 11.5, color: "#1E382B" }
          }
        ]
      };

      window.Plotly.react("single-park-plot", traces, layout, {
        responsive: true,
        displayModeBar: "hover",
        displaylogo: false,
        modeBarButtonsToRemove: ["lasso2d", "select2d"]
      });
    }
  }

  populateParkDropdown("Acadia NP");
  catSel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const curName = PARKS[Number(parkSel.value)] ? PARKS[Number(parkSel.value)].park : "Acadia NP";
    populateParkDropdown(curName);
    renderAll();
  });
  parkSel.addEventListener("change", renderAll);
  startSel.addEventListener("change", renderAll);
  endSel.addEventListener("change", renderAll);

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", renderAll);
  } else {
    renderAll();
  }
})();
</script>
'
))

attachDependencies(ui, list(plotly:::plotlyMainBundle()))
```
